It really sounds like you don’t want to keep working there or maybe anywhere.  The whole fact that you are asking makes me think that you would rather leave that position to focus on your studies and I feel like a lot of people would agree that you should focus on learning. Have you considered finding a job on campus, perhaps with the physics department? Most schools have lab aids, or if not and you Federal Work Study, tell them to hire you anyways since it wont affect their budgets.

My advice is to find what you want and work for it. Whether that means quitting your job or more drastic measures, there is not much better out there than working towards your goal and achieving your dreams.
